description: This Java class 'OtaPackageDataValidator' extends a base validator to perform validation logic for OTA package data, including size constraints, checksum verification, and update restrictions within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: OtaPackageDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class that validates OTA package data, ensuring compliance with size, checksum, and update rules.

methods.name: validateCreate
methods.description: Validates creation constraints for an OTA package, including maximum size per tenant.

methods.name: validateDataImpl
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of OTA package data, including checksum verification and URL/file consistency.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Validates updates to an OTA package, ensuring data integrity and size constraints.
